column1: # Extra worlds that passed their checks but do not fit the main card (24):
# Swap any of them for a main-card world; the module lists only the first 32
# world files in /kyklophoria. All VCSL (CC0), labels corrected an octave up
# (stage seven), exported --gate --clean. "clicks" = the note-change click at
# one voice that the -clickfix firmware addresses.
